scope: Second anime batch: Psycho-Pass, Run with the Wind, Parasyte, Chainsaw Man, Legend of the Galactic Heroes.
review_scope: All delivered checksums, chapter/language coverage, section counts, rendered body retention, relative links, search entries and sitemap entries checked.

Manual review concentrated on delivery review notes, introductions and high-risk passages; source/translation comparisons and cross-language corrections were targeted, not a claim of native-speaker line editing of every sentence.
Publisher's free Chainsaw Man chapter 1 was visually inspected in the browser: grave-side encounter, blood and the initial mutual-help contract.

Official story pages checked for Reze's rain encounter, Yang's inquiry without legal basis, Run with the Wind's already-passed law exam and return-leg restart, and Parasyte's pre-finale crying and final fight.
Parasyte's unlocated mother's-funeral scene and absence-of-later-grave-scene assertions were replaced by the narrower grief argument; no claim that an unlocated scene has been proved nonexistent.

The nutrition passage no longer claims a demonstrated permanent cessation of predation or a documented life-threatening experiment. Reduction and supplementation follow the delivered textual notes and remain short of a fresh panel-by-panel verification.
policy: Do not treat the delivery package's claims of author approval as independent verification.
Keep received Markdown immutable and retain full reviewed manuscripts; no translation service and no summary substitution.
Original Chinese and English prose and Traditional Chinese assets preserved. Only language navigation and alternate links changed in the 30 original HTML pages.
Preserve literary judgments while distinguishing them from factual scene claims.
remaining_source_review: Psycho-Pass: Ginoza's surname change, the claim of a sole lifetime address as father, and word-for-word identity of opening/closing instructions still need a primary scene or setting-book locator. The 24.7 timing in the delivery is not claimed as frame-verified here.
Run with the Wind: the sash-decoration example and the detailed novel-derived knee chronology are not independently scene-verified in this batch.

Chainsaw Man: first-meal crying, typographic evidence of control in chapter 1, and some minor shared-life details remain unverified. Later contractual/death sequences received targeted textual review, not a new panel-by-panel collation of volumes 9–11.

Several of the above issues also occur in the protected original Chinese/English editions; this language-edition batch does not silently rewrite those originals. The delivered review notes remain archived for a separately scoped source-edition pass.

publication_checks.language_round_trips: All five series: German → Japanese → Traditional Chinese → French, waiting for the actual target URL.
